Map peek is unobscured. Its Done action returns to Tools. Closing Tools restores the same introduction lesson.
Once the lesson hint is stable, the explicitly collapsed title stays collapsed across Tools open/close. Expansion restores the complete wrapped title.
No new visual findings. The earlier statistics/minimap and tutorial/Tools overlap findings are resolved on this exact producer.
execution_notes: Two initial412 inputs were denied after lease expiration, both with input_started=false. No input was dispatched. Control was explicitly reacquired, current UI inspected, then new explicit actions performed. Failed request records are retained. No automatic input retry.

An incoming tutorial hint expands the lesson through existing behavior; the320 first lesson-restored/full-title captures show this expanded state. stable-collapsed-restore/stable-full-title explicitly verify collapse preservation after the hint stabilized.

Final screenshot inspection found the320 topic rows changed: Overview spans the first row; Colony/Economy occupy the second, Military/World the third. Actions used prior geometry. All five visible labels are proven, but complete distinct selection coverage is unverified and must not be claimed.
